Validate dense motorcycle cut-in and blind-zone behavior without creating actuation authority.

Validate cross-traffic timing with synchronized perception and a controlled surrogate.
Validate blind-zone sensing, read-only vehicle inputs and multi-sensor uncertainty.

promotionRule: simulation -> engineering review -> required HIL/target evidence -> approved controlled-track evidence -> independent review; no stage may be inferred from an earlier stage
